components.title: Living Diagnostics reconciliation
components.activation_boundary: Run the existing diagnostics CLI or Operations Scheduler reconciliation job after evidence capture.

components.title: Grace reasoning to bounded execution
components.activation_boundary: Use the existing provider-neutral dispatch and execution-attempt boundaries; do not restart unrelated services.

components.title: Operations Scheduler reconciliation trigger
components.activation_boundary: The existing scheduler lease and job runner own activation; no second scheduler is permitted.

workflows.title: Developer change to candidate diagnostic knowledge
Grace reason to execute to evidence continuation

checkpoints.expected_input: Schema-valid packet with repository-relative changed files.
checkpoints.transition: Validate packet and compare artifact identities.
checkpoints.evidence_source: CLI result and preserved candidate packet.
checkpoints.probe: python tools/estate_diagnostics.py impact create --request REQUEST --output PACKET
checkpoints.success_criteria: Packet is accepted only when paths, provenance, and declarations are valid.
checkpoints.safe_boundary: Packet validation and candidate persistence only.
checkpoints.verification: Inspect candidate_promotion=false and packet source revision.
checkpoints.escalation: Missing or contradictory evidence requires revalidation review.

checkpoints.transition: Reconcile changed artifacts and affected checkpoint applicability.
checkpoints.expected_output: Freshness report with candidate knowledge and no canonical mutation.
checkpoints.success_criteria: Affected understanding is marked for revalidation when source identity changes.
checkpoints.safe_boundary: Existing reconciliation owner; accepted baseline advancement remains explicit.
checkpoints.verification: Canonical cookbook bytes remain unchanged and freshness lists affected checkpoints.
checkpoints.escalation: Baseline unavailable or invalid; packet cannot cover change.

checkpoints.expected_input: Resident request and current turn context.
checkpoints.transition: Determine whether bounded execution is warranted.
checkpoints.expected_output: Provider-neutral execution recommendation or final reasoning response.
checkpoints.evidence_source: Actual turn metadata and reasoning result.
checkpoints.probe: Inspect the request/reason boundary and correlation identity.
checkpoints.success_criteria: Recommendation is bounded and carries enough context for dispatch.
checkpoints.safe_boundary: Reasoning state only; do not execute an unvalidated recommendation.
checkpoints.verification: Dispatch receives the expected handoff schema.

checkpoints.transition: Create and run a provider-neutral execution attempt.
checkpoints.probe: Inspect attempt identity, provider result, and output persistence.
checkpoints.success_criteria: The attempt reaches a terminal state with durable evidence.
checkpoints.verification: Evidence references the same attempt and source revision.
checkpoints.escalation: Provider authority/capacity or malformed contract prevents safe continuation.

checkpoints.expected_output: Grounded continuation or explicit unresolved state.
checkpoints.evidence_source: Execution result reconciliation and actual turn metadata.
checkpoints.success_criteria: Continuation consumes authoritative evidence and downstream response is grounded.
checkpoints.safe_boundary: Evidence reconciliation; do not claim success from provider completion alone.
checkpoints.verification: Grace response cites the durable result/evidence boundary.
checkpoints.escalation: Evidence remains incomplete or Steward decision is required.

checkpoints.expected_input: Due job and valid scheduler lease.
checkpoints.transition: Scheduler claims the existing Living Diagnostics job.
checkpoints.probe: Inspect due state, lease owner, and attempt identity.
checkpoints.success_criteria: Exactly one valid owner runs the due job.
checkpoints.verification: Run result and lease reconciliation agree.
checkpoints.escalation: Ownership is ambiguous or stale recovery exceeds authority.

checkpoints.expected_output: Freshness report and durable scheduler completion evidence.
checkpoints.evidence_source: Freshness report and scheduler status event.
checkpoints.probe: Compare reconciliation result with the scheduled job attempt.
checkpoints.success_criteria: The existing reconciliation owner runs without a second scheduler or provider.
checkpoints.verification: Freshness report and scheduler event share the job identity.
checkpoints.escalation: Baseline or evidence authority is unavailable.

failure_seams.title: Diagnostic packet fails closed
distinguishing_probes: Run packet validation and inspect invalid_impact_packets.
risky_actions: Do not advance the accepted baseline to hide an invalid packet.

failure_seams.title: Execution completes without usable continuation evidence
symptoms: provider says done but Grace has no grounded answer
distinguishing_probes: Correlate attempt, result, evidence, and continuation identifiers.
risky_actions: Do not declare success from provider completion alone.
stop_conditions: Required evidence cannot be acquired or reconciled.

failure_seams.title: Scheduled reconciliation ownership is ambiguous
distinguishing_probes: Inspect scheduler lease owner, process existence, and job attempt identity.
risky_actions: Do not clear an active lease or restart unrelated scheduler services.
stop_conditions: Owner cannot be proved from durable lease and process evidence.
